caption:
A fireball flashed over Europe in 2017. It was one of the most reported ever.

A fireball is a meteor so bright that people see it from far away.
The dark streak is the shadow of the trail, on the clouds. The orange puff is the cloud it left behind.
The APOD fireball likely came from Taurid dust, from Encke’s comet.

What the astronomers say: The 2017 fireball was seen all over Europe, and many people reported it.

NASA picture: JPL, PIA22825. MISR, Bering Sea fireball, 2018.
